comment: (B) A SAC-LAND CAST AT ITS QUEUE POSITION. T3, three untapped Mountains, hand Shard Volley ('As an additional cost, sacrifice a land', 3 damage) + Lightning Bolt, opponent at 6 (the burn provider offers Volley on a lethal turn); the human queues Volley FIRST. Before: a sac-land cast was never a reorderable slot -- it ran in its own trailing loop after every other cast, so Bolt went first whatever the queue said (the "*" pin realises [cast Lightning Bolt] and the Volley after it, untraced). Now it is a step of the "**" sequence like any cast; both resolve for the T3 kill.
